title: Filing Lens
summary: Agentic RAG over Indian companies' annual reports: hybrid search with reranking, a LangGraph agent with calculator and table tools, and answers where every number cites its page, or abstains. Built around a golden evaluation set and a CI gate that blocks regressions.

title: SQL Copilot
summary: QLoRA fine-tuning of an open-weight 7B code model for text-to-SQL, with an execution sandbox for self-correction, served on vLLM and benchmarked against a frontier model on accuracy, latency and cost per 1,000 queries.

title: Two-Stage Recommender
summary: Production-style recommendations on the 31M-transaction H&M dataset: two-tower retrieval with FAISS, a LightGBM LambdaRank ranker on point-in-time features, a sub-100 ms serving budget and a simulated A/B test.
